turns.assistant_message: The eval gate is designed to be tolerant of missing or intentionally skipped metrics. When a metric is marked as **skipped** (e.g., because it is not applicable to a particular model version or the evaluation data is unavailable), the gate simply ignores that metric in its decision logic. Promotion to the next stage (staging or production) proceeds if **all non‑skipped metrics** meet their configured thresholds. If any required metric fails, the gate blocks promotion. This behavior ensures that a missing metric does not automatically cause a failure, while still enforcing that every metric that is evaluated must satisfy its target. The gate also logs which metrics were skipped for auditability, so downstream reviewers can see why a promotion decision was made despite incomplete coverage. [1]
